verdict.rationale: Claude offers 'Claude Managed Agents' — a pre-built harness explicitly positioned for 'long-running tasks and asynchronous work' in managed infrastructure — plus a consumer-facing 'Hand off and schedule tasks' feature and async Message Batches API, all supporting autonomous background execution. However, evidence is limited to brief docs/pricing-page mentions rather than a dedicated scheduling/triggers guide, and there's no independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliably these background automations run. Missing for 10: dedicated automation/scheduling documentation, setup details (triggers, monitoring, failure handling), and independent verification of background-agent reliability.
